title: PairRequest
description: Body of POST /api/v1/pair (QR pairing, LSP-1 sections 4.3.4 and 5.3; LSP/1.1 secure profile, Increment 3). The scanning device (B) proves it holds the invite secret `S` from the `libreshare://pair` QR code: `mac = HMAC-SHA256(S, "LSP1-PAIR-REQ\0" || fpB || fpA || nB)`, where fpB is the scanner's fingerprint, fpA the inviter's and nB the decoded `nonce`. The request needs a valid `X-LS-Auth` proof, and `sender.fingerprint` MUST equal the fingerprint the proof names (else 401 AUTH_INVALID). The request is held open until the inviter's user decides, at most 125 s. Mirrors PairRequest in packages/libreshare_core/lib/src/model/session_models.dart. Unknown members MUST be ignored.

sender.description: The scanning device. Unlike in a SessionRequest its `fingerprint` is mandatory: pairing pins it.
